UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and language preferences for Thirukkural Life Guide.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: User display name shown on Profile screen.

email.description: Optional email address from Google Sign-In, strictly owner-private.

displayLanguage.description: Preferred display language for Thirukkural explanations.

voiceLanguage.description: Preferred speech recognition locale for voice input.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

SavedKural.title: Saved Kural Guidance
SavedKural.description: A bookmarked Thirukkural couplet and personalized modern life solution.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

query.description: Original life problem spoken or typed by the user.

detectedSummaryEn.description: Empathetic English summary of the detected problem.

detectedSummaryTa.description: Empathetic Tamil summary of the detected problem.

kuralLine1Ta.description: First line of the Tamil Thirukkural couplet (4 words).

kuralLine2Ta.description: Second line of the Tamil Thirukkural couplet (3 words).

transliteration.description: Phonetic English transliteration of the couplet.

meaningTa.description: Clear Tamil explanation of the couplet.

meaningEn.description: Clear English explanation of the couplet.

practicalSolutionTa.description: Practical modern application in Tamil tailored to the user's situation.

practicalSolutionEn.description: Practical modern application in English tailored to the user's situation.

actionableStepTa.description: One concrete immediate action step in Tamil.

actionableStepEn.description: One concrete immediate action step in English.

topicTag.description: Short category label such as Stress, Anger, Career, Relationships.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when bookmarked.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on bookmark update.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-private user profile and language preferences.

/users/{userId}/savedKurals/{kuralDocId}.description: User-owned bookmarked Thirukkural couplets and modern guidance cards.
